summary.text: Brennan Barrington, a Libertarian Party candidate and central Ohio native with an aerospace engineering degree from Ohio State University, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Ohio's 15th Congressional District to Don Leonard.

He is a member of the Libertarian Party of Ohio's Central Committee, and in his survey he listed cutting taxes, spending and regulations and changing how elections are conducted among his campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Barrington says he was born and raised in central Ohio and has lived there for all but two years of his life. He graduated from Licking Heights High School and earned a Bachelor of Science in aerospace engineering from Ohio State University in 2019.
He describes himself as an advocate for electoral reform since the 2016 elections.

Within the Libertarian Party, Barrington has twice been a delegate to the Libertarian National Convention, once serving on its Platform Committee, and is a member of the Libertarian Party of Ohio's Central Committee, according to his survey. He advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Libertarian primary, receiving 489 votes.
He received 2.8% of the vote to Don Leonard's 51.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
